reason: Needs -> Reasoning: two of the five Needs describe as future work something this week's bridges show already partly shipped. need.c11c0e00b95e8236 asks safety engineering to rebuild refusals "to key on the calling account's entitlement rather than on payload content alone" - but the 2026-07-30 bridge (validation.50650b2e4ae81cd8) documents OpenAI already enforcing by account, disabling the operator's account rather than only filtering his content. The account-keying is built; what is missing is the GRANT direction, so that Need should be narrowed from "make refusals entitlement-aware" to "add a positive entitlement that lifts the default". Likewise need.a3fc33c8103e1561 (policy lead drafting the published carve-out) is partly delivered given the December 10, 2025 tiered-access post in validation.0451730d678a8dd3 - the document exists, the eligibility test and application route do not. Reframe both forward to the next unmet precondition. Runway defect applies: all five tasks say "H2 2026 through H1 2027" but parse to 2026-07-01..2026-12-31, ending before the 2027-01-01..2027-06-30 landing opens.
